# real

Real numbers (decimal and floating point)

## Index

| Operation                         | Description                   
|-----------------------------------|-------------------------------
| [`dec`](#dec)                     | Convert to decimal            
| [`rounding.mode`](#roundingmode)  | Sets the default rounding mode
| [`rounding.mode?`](#roundingmode) | Gets the default rounding mode
| [`trunc`](#trunc)                 | Truncate                      


## Operations

### dec

Converts a number into a decimal value.

Stack effects:
```
( x:Dec -- Dec )
( x:Rat -- Dec )
```

Example:

| Input        | Stack
|--------------|------
| `c 0xff dec` | `255`
| `c 1/2 dec`  | `0.5`

### rounding.mode

Sets the rounding mode to one of the following:
- ceil
- down
- floor
- half.up
- half.even
- up

If *m* is not one of the above, a invalid argument error is raised.

Stack effects:
```
( m:Text --  )
```

Example:

| Input                 | Stack                      
|-----------------------|----------------------------
| `rounding.mode?`      | `half.even`                
| `c 5.55 1 round`      | `5.6`                      
| `/down rounding.mode` | *rounding mode set to down*
| `c 5.55 1 round`      | `5.5`                      

### rounding.mode?

Gets the current rounding mode which is one of the following:
- ceil
- down
- floor
- half.up
- half.even
- up

Stack effects:
```
(  -- Text )
```

Example:

| Input            | Stack      
|------------------|------------
| `rounding.mode?` | `half.even`

### trunc

Truncates the number *x* which is the same as rounding to an integer
value towards zero.

Stack effects:
```
( x:Dec -- Dec )
```

Example:

| Input          | Stack
|----------------|------
| `c 3.9 trunc`  | `3`  
| `c -3.9 trunc` | `-3`
